headline: 2 registered workflows fit; one detail about your study decides between them.
points: Understood goal: a per-sample regulatory network.

choices.question: Which regulator type should the network model: transcription factors, miRNA regulators, or both?

options.label: Transcription factors only
options.description: Leads to LIONESS-PANDA · One TF-gene network per sample, plus the cohort network

options.label: Both TFs and miRNAs
options.description: Leads to LIONESS-PUMA · One TF + miRNA network per sample, plus the cohort network · Also needs miRNA list

choices.ordering: Each answer lists the workflows it leads to.
